description: Dataset containing load profiles of two machine tools, corresponding production schedules, lists of processed workpieces, and MES-based production timestamps is a data set deposited in TUdatalib by its authors Andreas Wächter, Technische Universität Darmstadt. Dataset accompanying the paper "Production lot-specific allocation of energy demand using data mining on machine tool load profiles" by Andreas Wächter [0000-0002-7687-253X] and Ivan Uzunov [0009-0005-3781-9946]. This dataset contains load profiles (electrical power measurements with timestamps) from two machine tools during the processing of different manufacturing orders and workpieces. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
